title: Echoes of the past
description: Echoes of the past is a passion project by beginner modder well uhh.. me!
body:
![Item Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82862de1ee194589c78531d737c3ed3e24541797.webp)Echoes of the past is a passion project by beginner modder well uhh.. me!

New Features-

New ''Aerinite Dimension" and "Aerinite Forest" biome

New ''Aerinite'' ore that spawns in the ''Aerinite Forest'' biome

New Aerinite based tools, weapons, armor, that are a step up from Netherite

Sadly the mod is now abandoned, I lost the hard drive with my Mcreator workspace, i do not wish to recreate the mod by hand, im just happy its semi-finished
